description: Feature inventory for the academic-writer plugin. A checklist for future audits: each top-level feature lists its subfeatures, the source of truth, runtime status, and known issues. status: ok | partial | broken | missing. Regenerate/extend this file whenever features are added or removed.

subfeatures.name: Init wizard (Preflight, Integrations, Profile incl. author_key, Gemini Onboarding, Style Analysis, Sources) with --quick mode
setup skill — one-question-at-a-time first-run wizard (basics, dependency check, ask-before-install per tool, Gemini key walkthrough per OS with a live check after restart, sample paragraph)
subfeatures.issue: Rewritten in the 0.15.0 cycle: setup saves profile.md in Step 2 (the SessionStart hook exports GOOGLE_API_KEY only when it exists), installs each missing tool only after an AskUserQuestion 'Install', never asks for the key in chat, and stores it via plugin settings (keychain) or a shell/user environment variable. The key check is `aw models check` plus a curl to the Gemini models list with the key in a header. The old gemini_raw MCP probe and the .academic-helper/secrets.json option are gone (aw reads only GOOGLE_API_KEY). Open: setup's 'No, Claude only' choice leaves every aw model step (all Gemini-routed) unable to run.

subfeatures.issue: src/scripts/extract-style-metrics.py now exists and emits computationalMetrics + frequentTerms; surfaced into profile.md's Style Fingerprint section by init

features.name: Thesis + outline (article logical structure)

subfeatures.name: Mode B: structured outline + word/paragraph sizing
subfeatures.issue: Sections exceeding thresholds.json writerUnit.maxWords are now decomposed into a units[] array of writer-unit subsections sized within writerUnit.minWords-maxWords (target writerUnit.targetWords), adjacent tiny units merged; decomposition is prompt-enforced (markdown agent instructions), not code-enforced
subfeatures.notes: The units[] word-bound decomposition (thresholds.json writerUnit.minWords/maxWords/targetWords) is enforced only by prose instructions in src/agents/architect.md (lines ~91-101) — no script validates it and no such script exists under src/scripts/. The current write flow validates the outline with `gate.py outline-v2` and checks drafted length with `aw draft`'s word-bounds gate; whether outline-time sizing and tiny-unit merging are checked anywhere is unverified.

subfeatures.name: Explicit premise→support→thesis-link logical model
subfeatures.issue: Every section and writer unit now carries an argument-graph node (id, claim, evidence[], depends_on[], thesis_link, argument_role nested as a field); validated up front by write/SKILL.md Step 5.5 (orphan/cycle/empty-evidence/topological-order checks) before section-writers are spawned, not just post-hoc in self-review

subfeatures.name: Mode C: ownership-only from user draft

features.notes: Rolls up from the outline subfeature (see its own notes): the writer-unit word-bound decomposition it performs is not verified anywhere in the pipeline, so the parent stays partial until that subfeature does.
